transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I’m not eating right. Some days it’s just coffee, maybe a piece of bread. My pants are getting loose, so… yeah, that’s why I came in.
Have you lost weight recently?
Yeah… I think so. My pants are kind of hanging loose, and I’m not really eating much—some days it’s just coffee and maybe bread.
Are you choosing to eat less or is it just not feeling like eating?
It’s not really like I’m choosing it. I just… don’t feel like eating. Most days I end up with coffee, maybe some bread, and that’s about it. My pants are loose now.
Are you trying to lose weight?
No… I’m not trying to. I just don’t feel like eating much. Some days it’s only coffee, maybe a piece of bread, and my pants are getting loose.
Do you feel sad or anxious when you think about eating or during meals?
I don’t know… I don’t really think about it like that. I just don’t feel like eating much.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No… I don’t think that’s it. I’m not really scared of gaining weight. I just don’t feel like eating.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
Yeah… I guess so. I used to walk by the lake sometimes, and I had these little model kits I’d work on. Now they just sit there. I look at them and it feels like they’re somebody else’s, not mine.
How much weight do you think you've lost?
I’m not really sure… I haven’t weighed myself. But my pants are loose now, hanging off me more than before. I’m hardly eating most days.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
Yeah… most days. I wake up and it’s just this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Like there’s nothing good waiting for me, so I just… keep my head down.
How many pounds do you think you've lost since this started?
I don’t know exactly… I haven’t checked. Maybe a few pounds, maybe more. My pants are loose, and I’m not really eating much.
Are you ever worried that if you start eating more, you might gain weight?
I don’t think so… I mean, I’m not really thinking about gaining weight. I just don’t feel like eating much.
Are you afraid of gaining weight when you think about eating more?
No… I’m not scared of gaining weight. I just… don’t have much appetite. Some days it’s only coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and my pants are getting loose.
How long have you felt like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
For a while now… I don’t know exactly how long. I used to like walking by the lake, and doing those little model kits, but now they just sit there. I look at them like they’re somebody else’s stuff.
When you think about doing things like walking by the lake or working on your model kits, do you think you would enjoy them if you did them?
I don’t think so. I mean… I used to like walking by the lake and doing the model kits, but now when I look at them, it’s like they’re not even mine. I can’t really picture enjoying it.
Do you feel like you would be interested in walking by the lake or working on your model kits if your mood was better?
Maybe… but right now it doesn’t feel that way. I used to like the lake and those little model kits, but they just sit there. I look at them like they’re somebody else’s things.
Are you happy about the weight loss you've experienced?
No… not really. My pants are just hanging loose now. I’m not trying to lose weight—I just hardly eat right anymore. Some days it’s just coffee, maybe a piece of bread.
Are you losing weight on purpose?
No… I’m not trying to. I just… don’t really eat much. Some days it’s only coffee, maybe a piece of bread, and my pants are getting loose.
Do you think your weight loss is making you look better?
No… I don’t think it makes me look better. My pants just hang off me now. I’m not eating right—some days it’s just coffee and maybe bread.
Are you relieved when you lose weight?
No… relieved isn’t really it. I’m not trying to lose weight. I just don’t eat much lately—coffee, maybe some bread—and my pants are loose.
Do you ever worry about what happens after you eat, like digesting food?
I don’t think so… I mean, I don’t really think about digesting it or anything like that. I just don’t feel like eating much.
